text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Slovak dealers said they think speculative presssure on the Slovak crown is finally over and that foreign banks on Tuesday afternoon started to buy crowns.

- The eight largest opposition parties said they agreed on one draft law on direct presidential elections. The opposition said it would call an extraordinary parliamentary sesssion where they would seek the dismissal of Interior Minister Gustav Krajci.
- The opposition Party of the Democratic Left (SDL) said it would propose its own draft law which should change the presidential electoral system to direct vote by citizens.
SME - Currency analysts said the crown liquidity shortage on the money market has become dangerous for banks payment relations with clients.

- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar on Tuesday proposed a successor for Foreign Minister Pavol Hamzik who resigned last month. But the government did not make public the name of the candidate saying it had yet to present the proposal to President Michal Kovac.
- The government on Tuesday approved the introduction of limit quotas on imports of Czech beer but did not say how big thw quotas will be.

- The state Council for Radio and Television Broadcasting on Tuesday said a little-known company ProTV won the tender for the rights to Slovak Television's (STV) second terrestrial cnannel. The winner of the tender must be approved by parliament before it can start broadcasting.

PRAVDA - Some 2,000 poeple gathered in front of the government building on Tuesday and called for Premier Meciar to resign, accusing him of thwarting the referendums on NATO and presidential elections last month.
- Slovakia's sole shipbuilder Slovenske Lodenice plans to post a pre-tax profit of some 82 million crowns in 1997. Overall revenues should total around 3.5 billion crowns.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) appears to be winning the battle for stability of the Slovak crown.
- Tne Finance Minister should propose basic principles for the 1998 state budget to the government by the end of this month.
